A small jewel-scaled fae dragon, no bigger than a cat, coils sleeping on a low branch nearby.
A pure-white unicorn steps silently into the glade, its horn glowing softly gold.
A great low moon fills the gap in the trees, vast and silver behind the court.
A portal of pale light blooms between two ancient oaks, its edges rippling like disturbed water.
A firebird blazes overhead, trailing ember-feathers that drift slowly down through the canopy.
A procession of fae lights winds between the roots below, tiny and blue-white as distant stars.
A guardian treant looms at the forest edge, its bark-face watching the court with patient amber eyes.
A shaft of divine light drops from above, striking the mossy ground in a column of pure gold.
A great horned owl descends from the dark canopy, settling silently on a high branch overhead.
A fountain of magical water rises from the pool's center, threading upward in a slow, luminous spiral.
A whole constellation reflects in the still pool below, burning cold and perfect beneath the court's feet.
A jewel-scaled fae dragon lifts its tiny head, one eye catching firelight like a cut emerald.
Twin trees frame a shimmering portal, through which a distant silver landscape breathes and glimmers.
The moon rises so close and low it seems one could reach out and press a palm against it.
A phoenix-like firebird banks between the treetops, each wingbeat scattering a cascade of orange sparks below.
A river of fae lights floats upward through the branches, drifting skyward like slow, living lanterns.
The treant guardian shifts one vast root, and the whole glade shudders gently underfoot.
Divine light floods from a break in the canopy, painting every leaf edge in molten copper and white.
The great owl spreads its wings once before folding them, the motion stirring every candle flame sideways.
Magical water rises and arcs in silence, catching moonlight along each curve like poured liquid glass.
The pool reflects Orion perfectly, each star sharp and deep as though the sky began there.
A tiny fae dragon uncurls from a mushroom cap, stretching iridescent wings no wider than a hand.
A unicorn pauses at the glade's edge, nostrils flared, its mane lifting in a wind felt by no one else.
The portal between the trees pulses once, exhaling a breath of cold perfume from somewhere impossibly far away.
The firebird passes so low its heat touches upturned faces, leaving a trail of slow gold smoke above.
